property.name: hbase.tmp.dir
property.description: Temporary directory on the local filesystem.

property.name: hbase.hfile.access.tracking.enabled
property.description: Enable HFile access tracking for metadata updates

property.name: hbase.hfile.access.queue.size
property.description: Max events in queue before dropping (200K = ~20MB memory)

property.name: hbase.hfile.access.worker.threads
property.description: Worker threads for processing access events (auto-tuned to CPU/4)

property.name: hbase.metadata.update.max.retries
property.description: Immediate retry attempts within worker thread

property.name: hbase.metadata.update.retry.delay.ms
property.description: Initial retry delay in milliseconds (exponential backoff)

property.name: hbase.metadata.update.max.total.retries
property.description: Max retries by FailedUpdateRetryManager before giving up

property.name: hbase.metadata.retry.interval.minutes
property.description: Retry failed updates every N minutes

property.name: hbase.metadata.update.failure.threshold
property.description: Alert when failure rate exceeds this threshold (5%)

property.name: hbase.metadata.max.tracked.failures
property.description: Max failed updates to track in memory

property.name: hbase.hfile.access.monitor.interval.sec
property.description: Log statistics every N seconds

property.name: hbase.hdfstier.max.storage.size
property.description: Maximum storage size for HDFS tier cache in bytes (default: 100 GB)

property.name: hbase.hdfstier.reconciliation.interval.minutes
property.description: Interval for reconciliation scan of hdfsTier:meta table to correct storage metrics (in minutes)

property.name: hbase.hdfstier.metrics.port
property.description: HTTP port for HdfsTier metrics server (exposes /metrics, /health, /reconcile endpoints)

property.name: hbase.hdfstier.eviction.enabled
property.description: Enable automatic eviction of HFiles when storage threshold is exceeded

property.name: hbase.hdfstier.eviction.policy
property.description: Eviction policy to use: LRU (Least Recently Used), FIFO, or custom policy class name

property.name: hbase.hdfstier.eviction.threshold
property.description: Storage usage percentage that triggers eviction (default: 90%)

property.name: hbase.hdfstier.eviction.target
property.description: Target storage usage percentage to evict down to (default: 70%)

property.name: hbase.hdfstier.storage.max.bytes
property.description: Maximum storage in bytes for eviction calculations (default: 100 GB, should match hbase.hdfstier.max.storage.size)

property.name: hbase.hdfstier.eviction.chore.period.sec
property.description: Period in seconds for the eviction chore to run (default: 300 seconds = 5 minutes). The chore checks storage utilization and triggers eviction if threshold is exceeded.

property.name: hbase.hdfstier.eviction.chore.delay.sec
property.description: Initial delay in seconds before the first eviction chore run (default: 60 seconds = 1 minute). Allows time for HBase to stabilize after startup.
